query: I have an 84-year-old male inpatient with pulmonary embolism. Among male inpatients aged 79–89 with PE and top‑quartile comorbidity burden, what is his composite risk score percentile? Also report 30‑day mortality, cardiac and neurologic complication rates, and median survival days.
final_sql: SELECT p.gender, percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY p.gender) AS percentile_rank FROM physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients p WHERE p.subject_id = 123456789 LIMIT 1;
